svg.aria-label: How a call flows. The browser opens the page and API over HTTPS, signalling over a WebSocket and media over UDP with DTLS-SRTP. One Go process runs the page and API, the signalling, a presence hub with one actor per room, and a Pion SFU that forwards each participant's media to the others.
